# Interview prep: Halden Freight Systems pilot review

Call: Friday 30 October 2026, 11:00 CET, Google Meet.
Panel: Ingrid Solberg (VP Engineering, hiring manager) and Tomas Weir (tech lead).

## Pilot facts
- The dispatcher pilot budget is EUR 42,000 for phase one.
- The dispatcher pilot is planned for Q1 2027.
- Lantern accuracy on the held-out set was 96.4 percent for totals and 91 percent for line items.
- The courier pilot ran for 10 weeks across 23 vans in Milan.
- Salary expectation: EUR 70,000 to 80,000 gross per year; flexible for equity.
